purpose: Planned parameter set for a full-domain 3-D AC SIP mechanism sweep before launching the solver.

runner.note: This script is reusable for sample16 even though the filename still says sample89. It does not currently parse this JSON directly; Codex will read this file and translate cli_arguments into a command when the run is requested.

sample_bulk_geometry_for_experiment_conv.notes: Length, diameter, Lambda, and formation factor are taken from the sample-16 rows in the physical-properties workbook. The selected REV porosity is recorded separately and is not forced to match plug-scale porosity.

definitions.maxwell: Two-phase water/solid AC3D solve with dc conductivity contrast plus high-frequency permittivity only.
definitions.pore: Niu paper-mode pore-only AC3D solve: water is sigma_w + Delta sigma_pore*, solid is zero. This is not pore minus maxwell.
definitions.membrane: Niu paper-mode membrane-only AC3D solve: water is sigma_w + Delta sigma_membrane*, solid is zero. This is not membrane minus maxwell.
definitions.all: Combined AC3D solve with Maxwell background plus pore and membrane increments.

solver.notes: The low-memory COCG backend is selected because the 500^3 REV has 125 million cells. The preconditioner and fft_reference fields are retained for command compatibility but are ignored by the low-memory COCG backend.

rationale.geometry: Use the full 500^3 REV at 1.92 um/voxel with downsample=1 because the user requested full-domain simulation before any further simplification. The REV porosity is measured from the selected TIFF and kept as provenance.
rationale.frequency: Use exactly the LKC-16 experimental frequencies, 0.1-20000 Hz with 51 points, so the simulation-to-experiment comparison is not an extrapolated frequency diagnostic.
rationale.water_sigma: Use 0.12 S/m from the sample-16 SIP parameter table as the electrolyte conductivity baseline. This controls the dc conduction through connected pore water.
rationale.solid_sigma: Use 0.0024 S/m from the sample-16 property table as the real solid/mineral background conductivity for Maxwell and total mechanisms.
rationale.permittivity: Use eps_w/eps0=80 and eps_s/eps0=7 to represent high-frequency dielectric storage in water and carbonate solid. Their contrast drives Maxwell-Wagner interfacial polarization in the AC3D field solve.
rationale.pore_polarization: Use Sigma_S=1.3e-9 S and D=1.3e-9 m2/s with the pnextract pore-radius distribution. Pore polarization is controlled by diffusion time scales tied to local pore radii.
rationale.membrane_polarization: Use eta0=0.01 and the pnextract throat length/resistance distribution with no empirical geometry scaling. This follows the current sample16 rule that formal runs should prefer extracted pore radii and throat lengths.
rationale.dynamic_pore_size: Use Lambda=2.45913 um from the sample-16 physical-properties workbook, not the old hard-coded 2.7 um default. Lambda maps microscopic conductance increments to apparent water conductivity.
rationale.scaling: Keep pore_radius_scale=1, membrane_length_scale=1, and membrane_zdc_scale=1. Any non-unit scaling should be treated as a sensitivity or diagnostic run, not the formal physical run.
rationale.solver: Use an actual AC3D field solve, not pnm-formation-factor, to preserve full-domain geometry and Maxwell field redistribution. Use gpu-cocg-lowmem/complex64 for memory feasibility on 125 million cells.
